text: **dsh-superpowers** 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 14 个 Superpowers 流程技能，并把启动指导加入系统提示词。技能涵盖头脑风暴、规划、TDD、调试、并行任务、工作区隔离和代码审查，适合希望采用结构化编码流程的 DSH 用户。需要 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.6+ 和 Node.js 22.19+ 或 24+，无需 API 密钥。

**dsh-superpowers** brings 14 development workflow skills to DeepSeek Harness and adds startup guidance to the system prompt. Skills cover brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging, parallel work, worktree isolation, and code review. Requires DSH 0.1.0-rc.6+ and Node.js 22.19+ or 24+; no API key.
我想先把一个模糊的功能想法梳理成设计和实现计划。
有没有办法让编码助手在写实现前先写失败测试？
帮我按步骤分析 bug 的根因，别一上来就改代码。
我需要把大型开发任务拆成互不依赖的小任务并行完成。
开始新功能前，怎么把工作隔离在单独的工作区？
想让 agent 根据规格生成细化到小步骤的实现计划。
让 DSH 在每次会话开始时都能使用开发流程指导。
我收到代码审查意见，想先验证再决定要不要照做。
「会话启动指导」：启动时把 using-superpowers 内容加入系统提示词，让技能使用规则从第一轮请求起可见。
「开发技能目录」：插件扫描 skills 子目录并注册含有效名称、描述和正文的技能，供 DSH 原生 skill 工具调用。
「工具名称映射」：启动提示中列出 DSH 的文件、shell、任务和搜索工具对应关系，说明上游 hook 与斜杠命令不适用。
「TDD 工作流」：测试驱动开发技能要求先写测试、观察失败，再写最小实现并验证通过。
「系统化调试」：调试技能要求先定位根因，再提出修复，适用于 bug、测试失败或异常行为。
可选的头脑风暴视觉伴侣会从 primeradiant.com 加载品牌图片；代码将该图片 URL 用于界面品牌素材。

dsh-superpowers README · dsh-superpowers：[dsh-superpowers](https://github.com/codeAnqiang-ma/dsh-superpowers) adds [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) support to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It registers 14 skills for brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging, and code review, and keeps the `using-superpowers` bootstrap active throughout the session.

dsh-superpowers README · From npm (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-superpowers
```

dsh-superpowers README · From GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:codeAnqiang-ma/dsh-superpowers#master"
```

After either command, stop and restart `dsh web`. Replace `web` with `headless` or a custom profile name when installing for a different surface, then restart that surface instead.

dsh-superpowers README · What it does：- Registers all 14 Superpowers skills on `ctx.skills`. They appear in the skill catalog and load through the native `skill` tool. Nothing is copied into `~/.dsh/skills`.
- Adds the `using-superpowers` bootstrap as the `superpowers:bootstrap` prompt section at order 50. It is present on the first request and survives context compaction because it is part of the system prompt, not a one-off session message.
- Maps Claude Code-style tool names such as `Task`, `TodoWrite`, and `Bash`/`Read`/`Write`/`Edit` to their DeepSeek Harness equivalents. The mapping also notes that hooks and slash commands are not available.

dsh-superpowers README · Verification：Check that the plugin is present in the profile:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The output should contain `id: superpowers` followed by `name: dsh-superpowers`.

Then start a new session and ask for a feature. The agent should explore first and respond with questions or a design instead of writing code immediately. Its tool calls should include `skill`.

dsh-superpowers README · Configuration：Every field is optional. Override fields in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: superpowers
  config:
    bootstrap: false
```

dsh-superpowers README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skills` | `true` | Register the bundled skills on `ctx.skills`. |
| `bootstrap` | `true` | Register the `using-superpowers` prompt section. |
| `toolMapping` | `true` | Append the DeepSeek Harness tool mapping to the bootstrap section. |
| `order` | `50` | Place the bootstrap after the persona (0) and before tool guidance (100–199). |

dsh-superpowers README · Configuration：Setting `bootstrap: false` keeps the skills discoverable but stops them from self-triggering; the model will use them only when it decides to consult the catalog.

dsh-superpowers README · Overhead：The bootstrap adds roughly 1.1k tokens (4,465 characters) to the system prompt of each request. The section is static and stays within the cached prefix. It is not appended as a new chat message on every turn. Set `bootstrap: false` to keep the skills without the fixed prompt overhead.

dsh-superpowers README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` or newer
- Node.js 22.19+ or 24+
- Zero runtime dependencies; the plugin reaches the prompt and skill registries through `ctx`

dsh-superpowers README · Upstream and license：The skills under `skills/` are vendored unmodified from [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) v6.3.0 at commit [`b36e082`](https://github.com/obra/superpowers/commit/b36e0829c6d0140e93cfef2ca599b1b07d4a7797). The exact upstream version and commit are recorded in `package.json`. Report skill-behavior issues to the [upstream repository](https://github.com/obra/superpowers/issues) and packaging issues to [this repository](https://github.com/codeAnqiang-ma/dsh-superpowers/issues).

dsh-superpowers README · Upstream and license：The optional visual companion in `brainstorming` loads an upstream-hosted logo containing the Superpowers version. It sends no project or prompt content. Set `SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY` to a true value to disable it.
